description: Studio environment and first-open presentation calibration. Adds the generated lighting-probe fixture (white plastic/CAD, neutral gray, black leather/enamel, red clearcoat paint, brass/chrome, emission and reference white/gray/black patches), measures the shipped procedural bake for neutral diffuse response, broad highlights and a dark-reflection floor against a product-owned neutral reference bake, checks the explicit world IBL/camera-rig split, exposure/background independence, world-stable IBL vs camera-relative key/fill/rim, preset/override stability, first-open framing and Car/Camera/Suit nonregression regions.

knownDefects.description: The shipping procedural Studio bake keeps a slightly warm key and cool fill (neutral diffuse chroma at or below 0.08). The product-owned neutral reference bake has zero panel chroma but a narrower highlight and lower dark-reflection floor, so it is measured and not selected.
knownDefects.label: limitation

knownDefects.description: No third-party HDR environment is shipped. The default is the product-owned analytic bake, selected because it is license-free, deterministic and measured at 128 texels/face; a 256-texel bake costs over 3x the residency for a response change below the calibration tolerance.
knownDefects.label: limitation
